meta.title: Roadmap · Cycling Zone
meta.description: What is being built next in Cycling Zone, and how players rate the plans.

voting.intro: Rate the plans below. Your votes help decide what gets built next. What comes after season 4, I decide with you in the Roadmap threads on the forum.
voting.importance: How important is it to you?
voting.error: Your vote was not saved. Try again.

shipped.title: Already built
shipped.subtitle: Things from the roadmap that are now live in the game.

races.title: Races
races.today: A full season calendar with scheduled races, results, standings, prize money and history, plus a race film of every finished stage.
next: A smarter season planner: overlapping races, fatigue and qualification rules you can plan a whole season around.
National championships, worlds and europeans: ride for your country, win the jersey, and coach a national team.
Realistic race routes modeled on real racing.
The racing math explained in plain words, without revealing exact numbers.

training.title: Training
training.today: Daily training: pick a session for each rider every day, plan form peaks, and let the assistant suggest a plan.
next: Training per race day: one rebuilt training page where you plan each rider around his races.
The training score for everyone: see how good each training day was, and steer your riders' development season over season.
Coaches as a real resource: balance training load and risk burnout if you push too hard.
Ready-made training programs, and later a way to share your own.

youth.title: Youth development
youth.today: Your own academy and a talent scout: find young riders, develop them, and decide on Graduation Day who moves up.
next: Your own young stars: choose the country your young riders come from, and steer which rider types your academy produces.
U23 and junior squads: two real squads under your first team, with a path from the academy to the top.

market.title: Transfers & auctions
market.today: The strongest part of the game right now: live auctions, auto-bids, transfers, swaps and negotiations between managers.
next: Deeper negotiation between managers.
A market that tells stories: rumors, rivalries and big moves the whole world talks about.
Rider values that make sense: values follow your rider's abilities and what the market really pays, and I explain how they are set.

club.title: Club & world
club.today: A demanding board with real goals, club finances with real consequences, your own staff, and a forum and messages to talk with other managers.
next: Earn renown: statistics, records and history that build your club's reputation in the world.
Road captains, mentors and teamwork: riders who lift the team around them.
A club museum: champions, legendary riders and the races people still talk about.
Friends and following: follow managers and riders across the world.
Negotiate your board's goals upward, for a bigger reward.
Invite a friend and build your rivalry together.
A living world feed of results, transfers and rivalries.
